description: First-run discoverability + interaction-friction checklist for pane interactions. Each item ties a discoverability requirement to its UI cue and to the regression test that validates it, plus a remediation. The suite parses this file and asserts every cited evidence test exists.

items.requirement: The splitter handle is visibly distinct (idle/hover/active) so users discover resize without instruction.
items.remediation: Render PaneSplitterPrimitive with PaneAffordanceTheme splitter_idle/hover/active colors.

items.requirement: Splitter handles meet the minimum mouse target size.
items.remediation: 1-cell rails always pass mouse; no action needed.

items.requirement: Splitter handles meet the larger touch target size, or large-target mode is available to reach it.
items.ui_cue: thickness >= 2 and span >= 3 (PaneInputModality::Touch); PaneAccessibilityPreferences.large_target enlarges to reach it
items.remediation: Enable large_target (enlarge_target) or use the 2-cell rail promoted on large viewports.

items.requirement: First-time users see discoverable cues for resize/reset/maximize/mode/scroll actions.
items.remediation: Surface pane_first_run_hints() in an onboarding affordance.

items.requirement: A single-pane workspace hints how to create panes.
items.remediation: Show pane_empty_state_hint() when the workspace has one pane.

items.requirement: Live resize gives clear feedback: ghost boundary, snap guide, and live size badges.
items.remediation: Render PaneResizeOverlay during an active drag.

items.requirement: Affordance feedback respects reduced motion (no essential motion-only cue).
items.ui_cue: PaneResizeOverlay is static; PaneAffordanceMotion steps under reduced motion
items.remediation: Overlay is static geometry; gate any emphasis via PaneAffordanceMotion.

items.requirement: Affordance colors meet WCAG contrast in default and high-contrast themes.
items.remediation: Paint affordances with PaneAffordanceTheme; enable high_contrast for AAA.

known_friction.summary: On small terminals the 1-cell splitter rail is below the touch target minimum (thickness 2).
known_friction.remediation: Large-target mode (enlarge_target) bumps the handle to >= 2 cells; web hosts additionally widen the hit area in CSS via data-pane-large-target.
